name: WorldspaceTextureDemo
_textures: LTEX FormIDs verified vs Skyrim.esm 2026-06-17 — base LDirt01 → Skyrim.esm:0x000C14 (BTXT layer 0, all 4 quadrants of every cell); blend LFieldGrass01 → Skyrim.esm:0x013428 (ATXT+VTXT layer 1, per-vertex alpha from worldspace_splatmap.png). Splatmap is an 8-bit grayscale PNG sized 97x65 = (3 cells x 32 + 1) x (2 cells x 32 + 1), matching the heightmap grid; non-zero pixels = grass coverage (centre-bright radial gradient).
